description.en: Father of Western Sufism (Maghrib-Andalusia); his silsila connects to virtually all North African orders || Bridge figure between Andalusian and Maghribi mystical traditions || [Historiographical note] His influence on Ibn Arabi is debated; certainly shaped the intellectual environment
